body: I step out of the train, the cold night air enveloping me as I pause at the carriage doors. The windows, once dark and uninviting, now seem like empty eyes staring back, radiating an ominous silence. A sense of unease grips my chest as I scan the deserted platform, the faint glow of streetlights and distant streetlamps the only signs of life. I quicken my pace, my heart beating in sync with my footsteps as I make my way through the station, my mind racing with thoughts of potential threats and escape routes.
